items.title: Domino’s Pizza shares rise after Baird upgrades stock on improving sales outlook
items.summary: Investing.com -- Shares of Domino’s Pizza Inc (NASDAQ:DPZ) rose 2.5% in morning trade Friday after Baird upgraded the stock to Outperform from Neutral, with analyst Analyst Chris O’Cull citing what he called a "clearer path to better SSS performance and franchisee profitability".
